issue.title: Bug: [system_health][Mellanox]: PSU temperature mock fails when selected PSU lacks temperature sysfs nodes

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

mellanox

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

The Mellanox system-health test selects a PSU that does not expose the required temperature sysfs nodes. Consequently,  test_device_checker  fails while attempting to mock the PSU temperature.

Failure test run:
[Failure logs: test_system_health.py](https://elastictest.org/scheduler/testplan/6a7d0a2b1c6297f01e8546b4?testcase=system_health%2Ftest_system_health.py&type=console)

### Steps to Reproduce

1.  Disconnect PSU1 and connect any other PSUs.
2. Run `system_health/test_system_health.py` on the Mellanox SN5640 testbed.
3. Allow `test_device_checker` to execute PSU temperature mocking.
4. Observe the failure when the test reads the selected PSU’s temperature threshold.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

#### Actual Behavior

`MellanoxDeviceMocker` selects a PSU without verifying that it is powered and supports temperature mocking. Reading the missing `psu1_temp1_max `node raises  `SysfsNotExistError` , causing  `test_device_checker`  to fail.

#### Expected Behavior

The mocker should:

• Discover the number of PSU slots from platform data.
• Select only a powered PSU.
• Prefer a PSU exposing both temperature and temperature-threshold nodes.
• Raise an explicit error if no powered PSU is available.

The system-health test should complete without attempting to access unsupported PSU sysfs nodes.

### Relevant log output

```shell
FAILED system_health/test_system_health.py::test_device_checker[str5-sn5640-5]

psu_mock_result, psu_name = device_mocker.mock_psu_temperature(False)

tests.common.helpers.mellanox_sensor_control_test_helper.SysfsNotExistError:
/run/hw-management/thermal/psu1_temp1_max not exist

1 failed, 5 passed
```

resolution.title: [system_health]: Fix Mellanox PSU temperature selection
resolution.description:
Select a powered PSU from the platform-reported PSU slots and prefer one that exposes the required temperature sysfs nodes. Fail explicitly when no powered PSU is available.

### Description of PR

Summary:
Fix Mellanox system-health PSU selection when a PSU does not expose the
temperature sysfs nodes required for temperature mocking.

Fixes #27025

### Test result

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
`system_health/test_system_health.py::test_device_checker` fails on the
Mellanox SN5640 when the selected PSU does not expose the required
`psu1_temp1_max` sysfs node.

The mocker assumed a fixed number of PSU slots, considered a PSU powered
based only on the existence of its power-status file, and did not verify
temperature-node support before selecting it.

Failure:
https://elastictest.org/scheduler/testplan/6a7d0a2b1c6297f01e8546b4?testcase=system_health%2Ftest_system_health.py&type=console

#### How did you do it?

- Read the PSU count from platform data instead of assuming two slots.
- Check the value of the PSU power-status node.
- Detect whether the PSU exposes both temperature and threshold nodes.
- Prefer a powered PSU that supports temperature mocking.
- Raise an explicit error when no powered PSU is available.
- Reuse helpers for resolving version-specific temperature sysfs paths.

#### How did you verify/test it?

Manual test run: https://elastictest.org/scheduler/testplan/6a7d145bd8c30ddb818dc064

#### Any platform specific information?
The failure was observed on a Mellanox SN5640 using hw-management
version `7.0050.3005`. The change applies to Mellanox platforms using
the system-health device mocker.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
NA
